Saved Views is available today for every customer on a paid plan. Until now, keeping your favorite filters, sorting, and grouping meant rebuilding them each time you opened a list. With Saved Views, you can capture the exact combination of filters, sort order, and columns you rely on, then return to it instantly, whether you're tracking overdue tasks, reviewing this sprint's backlog, or checking a teammate's workload.

Each user can create and save up to 50 views across your workspace, so there's room for every project, client, or recurring check-in you need. Views can also be shared with your team, making it easy to align everyone around the same setup, whether that's a standup board, a release checklist, or a client-facing summary, without anyone reconstructing filters from scratch.

This update is included in all paid plans at no extra cost, and it's ready to use right now, no setup or admin work required.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
